.engramdb/memories/tax-uses-round-half-even_01a0f82d-4be3-7d71-84b4-e4a6f50aa102.md:15:Tax amounts are rounded with banker's rounding (`decimal.ROUND_HALF_EVEN`), as decided with the finance team in March 2026. Do not use ROUND_HALF_UP.

Tax uses **banker's rounding**, `decimal.ROUND_HALF_EVEN`. The project's EngramDB memory records this as a decision made with the finance team in March 2026, and it says not to use `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

I couldn't confirm this in the code. A search for `ROUND_`, `quantize` and `round(` found matches only in the memory file, so the repo has no tax-rounding implementation yet. For now the memory is the only source for this.
